blocks.text: Jordan Avery
Finance and Operations Executive | Example City | jordan@example.test
Executive Profile

Finance and operations leader with experience building reliable accounting systems, supporting transaction preparation and improving business planning. Combines hands-on accounting leadership with disciplined cash forecasting, clear performance reporting and cross-functional execution.
Selected Leadership Experience
Interim Chief Financial Officer
Example Professional Services | 2023 to 2025

Led the accounting close, reconciled balance sheet accounts and established clear ownership for recurring monthly activities. Documented unresolved items and reviewed supporting schedules with the team before issuing management reports.

Built a rolling cash forecast from customer collections, payroll, supplier commitments and operating requirements. Explained changes against prior forecasts and identified decisions requiring leadership attention before cash constraints affected operations.

Developed operating budgets from required activities, staffing and resources. Challenged unsupported assumptions, worked with department managers to validate costs and documented the business rationale for planned expenditure.

Prepared financial information for transaction diligence and coordinated requests across accounting and operations. Maintained a consistent source of supporting evidence and tracked open questions through resolution.

Improved reporting on project profitability and working capital. Reconciled operational measures to the general ledger, explained material differences and helped managers focus on practical corrective actions.

Established a weekly operating review covering service delivery, billing, collections and staffing. Assigned owners to agreed actions and followed progress through completion without adding unnecessary reporting overhead.
